szenen.text: We tested twelve famous candlestick patterns on one point two seven million real candles. Only one of them beat chance.
Worst first. Range Breakdown, Double Top, Double Bottom and Three White Soldiers all did worse than no pattern at all.
Three Black Crows, both Engulfing patterns and the Range Breakout: all within chance.
Evening Star, Shooting Star and Morning Star: no real edge either.
Number one: the Hammer. Price rose after it fifty one point nine percent of the time, versus forty five percent with no pattern. Six point eight points better. Not yet tested as a trade after fees.
And the twist: after a Double Top or a Range Breakdown, price went against the textbook more often than with no pattern at all.
Every day we test one pattern live on a real chart. Guess along and follow.
